actions.action: Isolate the plant from other plants
Dab each visible bug with a cotton swab dipped in isopropyl alcohol
Alternatively remove bugs with a soft brush or gentle rinse
Thoroughly inspect leaf undersides, stem joints, nodes and base for more pests
Spray all surfaces with insecticidal soap or neem oil every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Inspect other houseplants and new plants for pests
Check whether bugs are cottony (mealybug) or smooth dome-shaped (scale)

reason: The answer names mealybugs but only alongside scale as an equal possibility, and its main advice of dabbing with alcohol and inspecting thoroughly matches the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
